comments.text: Looks like a live action version of a 30s or 40s cartoon, down to the thrown logs disappearing into the static, unchanging log pile in the background like it was done to save the animators time from having to recolor and animate the background cells. I love it.

comments.author: @jameskurien7996
comments.text:
This movie is so creative, imaginative and entertaining!  Thank you!  It starts out charming and just keeps getting crazier and funnier from there.  My wife initially said she didn't want to watch it but we both loved it.

The fights and gags were great and so imaginative. I love that we were watching a great, ludicrous action scene with beavers and then we realize it's also a  homage to a famous scifi chase sequence.  The cartoon-ish damage in the big fight scene is perfect!  Thank you!
